Degenerate random variables are independent, so the independence clauses are satisfied literally rather than only vacuously.

Let \(e_1,e_2,e_3\) denote the coordinate vectors in \(\mathbb R^3\), and consider
\[
B^{(2)}=
\begin{bmatrix}\sqrt3e_1&0\\0&\sqrt3e_2\end{bmatrix},
\qquad
B^{(3)}=
\begin{bmatrix}\sqrt3e_1&0\\0&\sqrt3e_3\end{bmatrix}.
\tag{19}
\]
Their columns satisfy the required squared-norm-three normalization.  By (17) and orthogonality of the displayed arm vectors,
\[
3^{-1}S_{B^{(2)}}=3^{-1}S_{B^{(3)}}={1\over4}I_2.
\tag{20}
\]
Thus, for example, both classes belong to \(\mathcal B_{1/8}\).  They are distinct in the projective quotient because their comparison-arm lines are respectively \(\operatorname{span}(e_2)\) and \(\operatorname{span}(e_3)\).

Under (18), \(\mu_1=\mu_0=\sigma_1^2=\sigma_0^2=c_L=c_U=0\), and hence \(Q(0)=0\).  The pilot empirical laws equal the same point masses for every positive pair of sample sizes, so also \(\widehat Q_L=\widehat Q_U=0\).  The definitions of the population and plug-in losses therefore give, for every \(B\in\mathcal B_{1/8}\),
\[
w(B)=0,
\qquad
\widehat w(B)=0,
\qquad
\mathcal A_{\mathrm{mm}}
=\widehat{\mathcal A}_{\mathrm{mm}}
=\mathcal B_{1/8}.
\tag{21}
\]
In particular, the outer-set conclusion holds identically.  Define a deterministic, hence measurable, plug-in selection by choosing \(B^{(2)}\) when \(m_1\) is even and \(B^{(3)}\) when \(m_1\) is odd.  It belongs to \(\widehat{\mathcal A}_{\mathrm{mm}}\) for every pilot sample by (21), but along \(m_1=m_0\to\infty\) it alternates between the two distinct quotient points in (19) and therefore has no point limit.  This proves the asserted existential failure without singletonness. \(\square\)

snapshot.stmt: If \(\mathcal A_{\mathrm{mm}}=\{B^\star\}\) in the projective quotient, then every measurable selection \(\widehat B\in\widehat{\mathcal A}_{\mathrm{mm}}\) converges almost surely to \(B^\star\).  Without the singleton condition, there exist bounded two-marginal instances satisfying the maintained assumptions for which the outer-set conclusion of thm:plugin-correspondence holds but some measurable plug-in selections fail to converge to a point.

assumptions.ass:unpaired-pilot: The two arm-specific pilot samples are mutually unpaired i.i.d. draws from \(F_1\) and \(F_0\), respectively, and their joint law is independent of \(W\sim\nu\).

prose_overlay.tldr: An unpaired pilot identifies the two potential-outcome marginals but not their cross-world copula.  The note converts the sharp Fr\'echet covariance interval into an endpoint maximum for Zhao's affine residual-variance criterion, solves the regular rank-two problem with finite exact-input certificates, and treats Zhao's full all-rank pseudoinverse carrier through a measurable arbitrary-real selector and a separate exact-input cylindrical-algebraic selector.  A compact stable all-rank carrier makes observable deployment auditable: its regret relative to the unrestricted value is bounded by the exact stability price \(b_n^{\mathrm{st}}\), pilot error, optimization tolerance, and the selected-rank variance bridge.  The triangle witness proves an exact robust reduction of \(4912/39525\) in the basis objective and a positive observable variance gap for one displayed pair of tie representatives; no universal strictness or free stability is claimed.
prose_overlay.related_work: Zhao2026OptimalControlVariates supplies the network control-variate objective, the pseudoinverse convention, and the zero-covariance surrogate.  AronowGreenLee2014SharpVariance supplies the sharp Fr\'echet covariance endpoints and their attainment; Bergin1999RestrictedMarginals informs continuity of fixed-marginal coupling extrema.  MikhaeilGreen2024SharpRegressionAdjustment establishes sharp regression-adjusted variance-bound methodology, but does not select a pseudoinverse control-variate basis from unpaired marginal pilots under cross-world copula ambiguity or connect such an all-rank selection to observable-regret performance.  HarshawMiddletonSavje2026 optimizes variance estimation under interference and complex experimental designs; it does not deliver the fixed-assignment-law, cross-world endpoint basis-selection or rank-adaptive external-pilot deployment theorem proved here.  AronowSamii2017 supplies the exposure-mapping design foundation.  Real-closed-field quantifier elimination and cylindrical algebraic decomposition supply exact finite certificates on algebraically encoded inputs, while the countable dense selectors used for arbitrary real pilots are explicitly nonconstructive and have no finite stopping test.  CaiDeJanvrySadoulet2015 and Zhao's reanalysis motivate the unexecuted Jiangxi PICC protocol, but authenticated replication data are not available and no numerical application result is asserted.
prose_overlay.interpretation: The causal target remains \(\tau\); the quantities \(w^+(B)\), \(v_{\mathrm{mm}}^+\), and \(V_{\mathrm{st}}\) are respectively an ex ante worst-copula basis loss, its unrestricted design value, and the observable selected-basis performance.  Robust basis selection is therefore a design decision for estimating \(\tau\), not an identification formula for \(\tau\).  Rank-zero selection is exactly the uncontrolled Horvitz--Thompson fallback.  Positive-rank observable guarantees require certified spectral and coordinate stability, and the cost of imposing those restrictions is the visible, potentially nonzero quantity \(b_n^{\mathrm{st}}\).
prose_overlay.technical_internal_limitation: The full pseudoinverse objective is discontinuous across uncontrolled rank changes, so arbitrary-real pilot optimization is supplied only as a classical measurable positive-tolerance selector.  Finite CAD certificates require rational or real-algebraic endpoint input.  The stable observable theorem assumes the entire displayed error sum, including \(b_n^{\mathrm{st}}\), is \(o(n^{-1})\) for its first-order conclusion; the design-rate assumptions alone control only the bridge remainder.  The exact triangle observable comparison concerns one displayed pair of tie representatives, and the Jiangxi PICC protocol remains heuristic, internally cross-fitted, and unexecuted.
prose_overlay.honest_scope: The paper proves endpoint reduction, exact-input global certification, arbitrary-real measurable positive-tolerance selection, plug-in value regret, stable all-rank observable regret, and explicit triangle nonvacuity.  It does not claim a semidefinite-program reduction, a uniform complexity bound, a zero-tolerance arbitrary-real algorithm, universal full-carrier attainment, cross-rank outer-argmin convergence, point convergence under ties, universal strict improvement, or a zero rate for the stability price.  No Wald limit law is claimed; the delivered inference-side quantity is the finite ex ante expected conditional design-variance comparison for the displayed observable estimator.

project_justification.gap: Zhao's ex ante control-variate basis depends on a cross-world covariance that separate arm-specific pilot samples do not identify.  Existing sharp covariance bounds do not by themselves provide a globally certified basis optimizer, an all-rank pseudoinverse selector, or a bridge from the selected objective to the observable estimator under rank changes.
project_justification.niche: The experimental network, exposure maps, and assignment law are fixed and known, while two independent unpaired pilot samples identify exactly the two bounded marginal laws.  This separates design randomness from the ex ante dependence-robust basis decision and makes the unidentified copula the sole ambiguity in the endpoint objective.
project_justification.fill: The paper imports the sharp Fr\'echet covariance range, proves affine endpoint reduction, gives projective and rank-stratified certified optimization procedures, proves plug-in value and selector regret, and exposes a stable all-rank deployment carrier.  Unlike sharp adjusted-variance-bound results and optimized interference variance-estimation results, it jointly selects an all-rank control-variate basis against fixed-marginal copula ambiguity from an external unpaired pilot and bounds its observable deployment regret.  Its observable guarantee pays the explicit term \(b_n^{\mathrm{st}}=v_n^{\mathrm{st}}-v_{\mathrm{mm}}^+\) and a finite rank-adaptive bridge remainder rather than assuming singular-rank stability.

sampling_model.design: The main experiment uses a fixed finite network \(G\), known assignment law \(\nu\), known exposure maps \(f_i\), and two mutually exclusive exposure events.  Conditional on the selected basis and fixed potential-outcome array, the assignment \(W\sim\nu\) is the only design randomness.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The two arm-specific pilot samples are independent, unpaired, bounded draws from \(F_1\) and \(F_0\), and are independent of the main experiment.  Empirical means, variances, and quantile-coupling endpoints determine the plug-in endpoint matrices; no pilot pairing or copula estimator is used.
sampling_model.units: The causal estimand is the fixed finite-population contrast \(\tau=n^{-1}\sum_i\{Y_i(1)-Y_i(0)\}\).  The law \(H^{\otimes n}\) is used only for ex ante basis-performance averaging and does not replace the design-based estimand by a superpopulation target.
sampling_model.treatment: Exposure is determined by the declared maps \(f_i(W)\); exposure positivity licenses inverse-probability weighting, and the known-exposure condition links the observed outcome to the appropriate exposure potential outcome.
sampling_model.overlap: Every \(\pi_{i,a}\) is positive.  The regular rank-two class requires \(\lambda_{\min}(n^{-1}S_B)\ge\kappa\); the stable all-rank carrier instead contains the exact rank-zero fallback and positive-rank strata with declared thresholds \(\lambda_{1,n}\) and \(\lambda_{2,n}\), together with the coordinate envelope \(\overline a\).

thm:fixed-basis-endpoints.justification: This theorem reduces every fixed ordinary basis's copula adversary to two computable endpoint evaluations using only the algebraic design conditions and imported covariance interval.
thm:fixed-basis-endpoints.gap: It combines Zhao's covariance-dependent gain with Aronow--Green--Lee's sharp scalar endpoints; known exposure and i.i.d. pairs are not part of its algebraic proof basis.
thm:fixed-basis-endpoints.consumer: It feeds both robust optimization and the sequential pilot-to-worst-copula variance bridge.

thm:plugin-correspondence.justification: Uniform convergence over the compact regular projective class yields value consistency and the strongest generic set-valued optimizer guarantee.
thm:plugin-correspondence.gap: Marginal endpoint consistency alone does not imply uniform global objective or argmin-correspondence consistency.
thm:plugin-correspondence.consumer: An independent unpaired pilot may select a robust basis without claiming to observe the cross-world copula.

prop:unique-saddle-point-convergence.justification: The corrected statement shows that uniqueness on the compact quotient automatically creates every required neighborhood gap; endpoint uniqueness is unnecessary.
prop:unique-saddle-point-convergence.gap: Outer-set consistency cannot imply convergence of arbitrary selections under ties, as the explicit degenerate bounded instance demonstrates.
prop:unique-saddle-point-convergence.consumer: Applied reports should claim point convergence only after verifying a unique projective minimizer.

thm:relative-open-persistence.justification: Positive full-correspondence separation plus optimizer-wide regularity slack is sufficient for strict dominance to persist locally.
thm:relative-open-persistence.gap: General dependence-robust optimization results do not establish this moving-feasible-set statement for Zhao-type projective bases.
thm:relative-open-persistence.consumer: Any exact lawful witness satisfying the two displayed certificates activates a relative-open dominance region.

prop:kappa-exhaustion.justification: The compact threshold classes exhaust every ordinary-invertible block-separable matrix after quotienting independent nonzero arm-column rescaling.
prop:kappa-exhaustion.gap: Zhao2026OptimalControlVariates regulates supplied bases but does not construct this compact exhaustion or its quotient certificate.
prop:kappa-exhaustion.consumer: Certified optimizers can report \(\kappa\) while retaining an exact full ordinary-domain interpretation modulo rescaling.

lem:ht-affine-drift.justification: The drift identity is the algebraic reason the primary decision must minimize residual variance rather than maximize guaranteed gain.
lem:ht-affine-drift.gap: Neither the imported covariance bounds nor the covariance-dependent gain formula accounts for the endpoint-dependent uncontrolled variance term in the robust decision.
lem:ht-affine-drift.consumer: The formula lets a downstream reader compute the endpoint residual losses and detect which endpoint is adversarial.

thm:triangle-minimax-separation-certific.justification: The exact triangle witness certifies every equality case on both optimizer correspondences, the positive loss gap, and optimizer-wide regularity slack.
thm:triangle-minimax-separation-certific.gap: Zhao2026OptimalControlVariates supplies the zero-covariance surrogate but not this nondegenerate full-equality-set strict-separation certificate.
thm:triangle-minimax-separation-certific.consumer: The completion-relative-open theorem turns its separation and slack into a lawful neighborhood result.

prop:kappa-value-exhaustion.justification: The fixed-threshold minima exhaust the positive-definite rank-two projective restriction in value.
prop:kappa-value-exhaustion.gap: Its full unquotiented pullback is still only the rank-two restriction, not the note's constructed all-rank projective completion.
prop:kappa-value-exhaustion.consumer: The separate full-class value-transfer theorem supplies equality with the rank-stratified infimum.

thm:triangle-relative-open-dominance.justification: The exact triangle certificate is strengthened to a neighborhood guarantee retaining more than half its rational margin.
thm:triangle-relative-open-dominance.gap: A single strict example would not by itself show that the improvement is robust to perturbing the design and pilot marginals.
thm:triangle-relative-open-dominance.consumer: Nearby lawful instances inherit a strict comparison between every minimax optimizer and every zero-covariance optimizer.

oeq:moment-complete-finite-epsilon-solve.justification: This node tracks the only remaining generic certification gap separately from the solved triangle instance.
oeq:moment-complete-finite-epsilon-solve.gap: Classical box branch-and-bound results do not directly discharge the quotient, equality-boundary, kink, and outer-set termination requirements together.
oeq:moment-complete-finite-epsilon-solve.consumer: A positive solution would supply a finite auditable global certificate for every moment-complete encoded design instance.

thm:certified-global-basis-input-obstruc.justification: The exact two-law witness proves that \(\Pi,\Omega,c_L,c_U,\kappa,\varepsilon\) alone cannot determine the minimax residual value: the same displayed tuple yields values zero and \(1/36\).
thm:certified-global-basis-input-obstruc.gap: This theorem establishes necessity of endpoint moment information.  Sufficiency and finite instance-dependent termination are supplied separately by the corrected moment-complete solver theorem.
thm:certified-global-basis-input-obstruc.consumer: It justifies the moment-complete certified input interface and prevents a certificate from silently omitting the marginal second moments.

thm:moment-complete-finite-epsilon-solve.justification: From compact quotient charts, effective loss moduli, exact feasibility decisions, and nested feasible-box extraction, the theorem derives finite termination and a checkable \(\varepsilon\)-global value and outer-minimizer certificate.
thm:moment-complete-finite-epsilon-solve.gap: The guarantee is finite and instance-dependent; it provides neither a uniform complexity bound nor a semidefinite-program reduction.
thm:moment-complete-finite-epsilon-solve.consumer: It is the global optimality certificate for choosing a minimax-residual basis from the fixed normalized \(\kappa\)-regular projective class.

thm:algebraic-finite-epsilon-solver.justification: Locally checkable compact fixed-kappa rank-two branch-and-bound certificate.
thm:algebraic-finite-epsilon-solver.gap: The separate full-class theorem uses rank-stratified CAD and does not return an exact outer-argmin set.

thm:triangle-completion-separation-certi.justification: The exact triangle computation covers all rank-two bases and the note-constructed singular strata of its projective completion, excluding every singular optimizer tie.
thm:triangle-completion-separation-certi.gap: It supplies the explicit strict witness and regularity slack needed for neighborhood persistence; the quotient and its singular strata are the note's construction, while Zhao supplies the block parameterization and spectral pseudoinverse convention.

thm:zhao-ordinary-domain-quotient-transf.justification: Exact rescaling-fiber transfer for the positive-definite rank-two restriction.
thm:zhao-ordinary-domain-quotient-transf.gap: The unquotiented object here is only the ordinary rank-two restriction used for the note's comparison construction; it is not the note's rank-stratified projective completion.
thm:zhao-ordinary-domain-quotient-transf.consumer: Fixed-threshold exhaustion and triangle rank-two separation use this exact quotient map.

thm:completion-domain-value-and-optimize.justification: Canonical full-carrier theorem on the note's projective quotient: it proves infimum equality by one-sided rank-two projector approximation and states conditional equality-set transfer without assuming attainment.
thm:completion-domain-value-and-optimize.gap: Zhao supplies the block parameterization and spectral convention, but not the note's endpoint-robust rank-two density and value transfer on its constructed completion.
thm:completion-domain-value-and-optimize.consumer: The full-class solver, plug-in value theorem, and triangle certificate use this hierarchy.

thm:triangle-zhao-ordinary-domain-separa.justification: Transfers the exact triangle equality sets only to the unquotiented positive-definite rank-two restriction.
thm:triangle-zhao-ordinary-domain-separa.gap: It no longer calls that restriction Zhao's maximal ordinary domain.
thm:triangle-zhao-ordinary-domain-separa.consumer: The full-carrier triangle theorem separately handles published ranks zero and one.

thm:triangle-completion-relative-open-do.justification: This theorem shows that the exact triangle advantage is stable to lawful perturbations of the design and pilot marginals.  Unlike HarshawMiddletonSavje2026, which concerns optimized variance estimation under interference and complex experimental designs, it fixes the network and assignment law and compares cross-world-copula-robust versus zero-covariance control-variate basis choices.
thm:triangle-completion-relative-open-do.gap: A positive gap at one isolated law would not establish a robust design phenomenon; persistence also requires optimizer-wide interior regularity and strict rank-stratum gaps.  The theorem does not claim to extend HarshawMiddletonSavje2026's variance-estimation target or optimization problem.
thm:triangle-completion-relative-open-do.consumer: It delivers the claimed relative-open neighborhood on which every robust optimizer beats every zero-covariance optimizer for this fixed-design basis problem.

lem:dominance-gap-lower-semicontinuity.justification: The lemma propagates marginal and design continuity through the moving \(\kappa\)-feasible set and both optimizer correspondences.
lem:dominance-gap-lower-semicontinuity.gap: Fixed-marginal coupling continuity alone does not control minimax and surrogate optimizers when feasibility also moves with the assignment law.
lem:dominance-gap-lower-semicontinuity.consumer: The relative-open triangle theorems use it to retain a quantitative fraction of the exact separation margin.

thm:ordinary-inverse-strict-improvement-.justification: This theorem gives the exact ordinary-inverse frontier for when copula-robust residual minimization strictly improves on the zero-covariance optimizer set.
thm:ordinary-inverse-strict-improvement-.gap: The penalty over the noncompact zero-covariance equality face is correctly represented by an infimum; no penalty minimizer, singular completion, or universal strictness is assumed.

thm:pilot-selected-ht-first-order-varian.justification: This theorem combines uniform pilot endpoint control with the proved directed-local regular rank-two bridge to obtain finite selection regret and first-order feasible-estimator variance transfer.
thm:pilot-selected-ht-first-order-varian.gap: The proposed notation keeps the plug-in error distinct from neighborhood size.  The zero-surrogate comparison still needs the displayed bounded deterministic geometry constant and remains restricted to an external independent pilot.

prop:ordinary-domain-feasible-ht-gap-tra.justification: The proposition transfers an attained ordinary-domain population gap to a finite-pilot observable Horvitz--Thompson-coefficient variance gap using explicit pilot and directed-local bridge remainders.
prop:ordinary-domain-feasible-ht-gap-tra.gap: Optimizer containment, the exact pilot sensitivity premise, and a uniformly bounded geometry error constant remain separate hypotheses; the fixed triangle witness alone does not supply a triangular-sequence theorem.
prop:ordinary-domain-feasible-ht-gap-tra.consumer: It is the operational finite-n design-side diagnostic for independent-pilot positive-definite rank-two deployment.

lem:uniform-pilot-endpoint-matrix-rate.justification: The projector-order calculation isolates the true pilot sensitivity and supplies a dependency-degree-free first-order sufficient boundary.
lem:uniform-pilot-endpoint-matrix-rate.gap: It retains the exact condition \(nC_n\mathbb E_PM_n\to0\) and proves \(\sqrt{m_1\wedge m_0}/n^{1+\beta}\to\infty\) only as a sufficient specialization.

lem:uniform-zhao-ht-oracle-variance-equi.justification: This is the quantitative regular rank-two feasible-estimator bridge.  It derives the finite remainder from Zhao's directed coordinate-versus-complement neighborhoods using the singleton criterion and explicit multiplicity and directed-cycle counting with universal constants 8 and 64.
lem:uniform-zhao-ht-oracle-variance-equi.gap: Uniformity additionally requires bounded outcomes, the coordinate envelope, normalized kappa-regularity, exposure-probability control, and the first-order exponent condition; no separated-set dependency graph or singular-rank coefficient rate is used.

lem:zhao-rank-two-stratum-identification.justification: Identifies the note's ordinary rank-two quotient with the rank-two stratum in this note's constructed rank-stratified projective completion.
lem:zhao-rank-two-stratum-identification.gap: It does not call the quotient itself a class published by Zhao.
lem:zhao-rank-two-stratum-identification.consumer: Projector approximation and all full-class triangle transfers.

lem:rank-stratified-projector-reduction.justification: The projector representation isolates the only rank-dependent part of every endpoint gain and proves domination by maximal achievable rank without assuming rank two exists.
lem:rank-stratified-projector-reduction.gap: A rank-two-only perturbation cannot support full-carrier selection on designs whose attainable rank is one or zero.
lem:rank-stratified-projector-reduction.consumer: The maximal-rank countable selector and both full-carrier pilot regret results use the projector convergence and positive-semidefinite trace monotonicity.

lem:triangle-completion-singular-strata-.justification: Computes exact rank-zero and rank-one bounds for the note-constructed rank-stratified projective completion using Zhao's spectral convention.
lem:triangle-completion-singular-strata-.gap: The singular strata are part of this note's explicit projective rank completion; they are not attributed to a projective all-rank domain published by Zhao.
lem:triangle-completion-singular-strata-.consumer: The full-carrier triangle theorem uses the strict singular margins to exclude ties.

thm:zhao-pseudoinverse-rank-stratified-e.justification: Computable epsilon-value certificate over every rank in this note's constructed projective completion.  GaoKleywegt2017DependenceRobust studies dependence-robust ambiguity sets and dual reformulations; this theorem instead fixes the two marginals, uses their sharp Fréchet covariance endpoints, and certifies a nonconvex control-variate-basis problem by rank-stratified CAD rather than by a DRO dual reduction.
thm:zhao-pseudoinverse-rank-stratified-e.gap: It certifies an infimum and epsilon sample even when the equality set is empty.  The fixed-marginal endpoint certificate is distinct from the dependence-ambiguity-set duality studied by GaoKleywegt2017DependenceRobust.
thm:zhao-pseudoinverse-rank-stratified-e.consumer: Design preparation can audit a full-class robust value without an SDP or exact-attainment claim.

thm:zhao-pseudoinverse-plugin-value-and-.justification: Uniform endpoint-matrix convergence and the maximal-rank selector give full-carrier value consistency without assuming attainment across rank changes.
thm:zhao-pseudoinverse-plugin-value-and-.gap: The result concerns the basis objective and deliberately gives no singular-rank observable-estimator bridge.
thm:zhao-pseudoinverse-plugin-value-and-.consumer: The stable observable theorem uses its uniform full-carrier pilot modulus.

lem:full-carrier-plugin-objective-regret.justification: A uniform all-rank projector modulus converts pilot endpoint-matrix error and optimization tolerance into an explicit full-carrier regret bound.
lem:full-carrier-plugin-objective-regret.gap: The former statement carried a rank-two-existence premise not used by the all-rank matrix inequality.
lem:full-carrier-plugin-objective-regret.consumer: The theorem on pilot value consistency uses its uniform modulus, while triangular-sequence readers can use its explicit pilot-size rate.

lem:full-carrier-countable-measurable-se.justification: This lemma supplies the measurable arbitrary-real positive-tolerance rule on Zhao's full pseudoinverse carrier.
lem:full-carrier-countable-measurable-se.gap: The countable infimum and first qualifying index are set-theoretic objects and have no finite stopping test for arbitrary real pilot observations.
lem:full-carrier-countable-measurable-se.consumer: The unrestricted plug-in value theorem and objective-regret rate use this selector.

lem:bounded-unpaired-endpoint-strong-con.justification: This pilot-only lemma turns empirical marginal convergence into operator-norm convergence of both endpoint moment matrices.
lem:bounded-unpaired-endpoint-strong-con.gap: Unpaired pilots identify the margins and sharp endpoints but not a cross-world copula.
lem:bounded-unpaired-endpoint-strong-con.consumer: It supplies the almost-sure input convergence used in the full-carrier pilot value theorem and is unchanged by the selector-rank correction.

thm:encoded-cad-pilot-selector-certifica.justification: This is the finite, locally checkable counterpart to the unrestricted nonconstructive countable selector.
thm:encoded-cad-pilot-selector-certifica.gap: It requires exact rational or real-algebraic empirical endpoint input and does not by itself certify positive-rank deployment stability.
thm:encoded-cad-pilot-selector-certifica.consumer: Exact-input deployments use its rank and spectral record either directly or as the unrestricted benchmark for the stable CAD certificate.

thm:rank-adaptive-oracle-observable-vari.justification: The theorem gives the exact rank-zero identity and a finite observable-to-oracle variance bound on certified stable rank-one and rank-two strata, with rates proved from Zhao's directed local neighborhoods and explicit constants 8 and 64.
thm:rank-adaptive-oracle-observable-vari.gap: A pilot-selected positive-rank class is covered only after its spectral-isolation record and coordinate check certify a positive-eigenvalue margin and envelope; pilot independence does not imply either condition, and no stability across uncontrolled rank changes is claimed.
thm:rank-adaptive-oracle-observable-vari.consumer: It converts full-carrier objective performance into ex ante conditional design-variance performance only on certificate-verified rank strata.

thm:cad-primitive-containment-error-gap-.justification: It derives optimizer containment, transverse quadratic growth, the global nominal-to-robust error constant, and a positive gap from finite auditable CAD, KKT, derivative, and remainder records.
thm:cad-primitive-containment-error-gap-.gap: The proposed record requires a refined stratum cover of the local neighborhood; any observable-variance use must separately satisfy the rank-adaptive bridge's spectral and coordinate certificates.
thm:cad-primitive-containment-error-gap-.consumer: Certified pilot comparisons can replace bare containment and bounded-error premises with a locally checkable CAD/KKT record.

thm:cad-certified-positive-improvement-n.justification: The exact triangle enumeration shows that the certified machinery can produce a strictly positive observable robust-versus-surrogate variance gap.
thm:cad-certified-positive-improvement-n.gap: The witness is existential over one displayed pair of tie representatives and is not a universal tie-breaking or neighborhood result.
thm:cad-certified-positive-improvement-n.consumer: It supplies a finite lawful stress test for the observable deployment claim.

thm:encoded-cad-stable-pilot-selector-ce.justification: The finite exact-input record certifies empirical near-optimality, selected rank, coordinate bounds, spectral margins, and an enclosure of the stability price.
thm:encoded-cad-stable-pilot-selector-ce.gap: It applies only to exact rational or real-algebraic empirical and population endpoint inputs.
thm:encoded-cad-stable-pilot-selector-ce.consumer: Exact-input stable deployments can audit every condition required by the rank-adaptive observable bridge.

thm:stable-rank-adaptive-full-carrier-ob.justification: This is an all-rank robust basis-selection and observable-regret theorem: it combines stable-carrier pilot regret with an eventwise rank-adaptive variance bridge to control the observable estimator relative to the unrestricted full-carrier value.  MikhaeilGreen2024SharpRegressionAdjustment supplies sharp adjusted-variance endpoint analysis, but not selection of a pseudoinverse control-variate basis from unpaired marginal pilots under cross-world copula ambiguity or an all-rank observable-regret bridge.  HarshawMiddletonSavje2026 studies optimized variance estimation under interference and complex designs, but not this fixed-design, cross-world-robust basis-selection target, its external unpaired-pilot input, or its rank-zero/rank-positive deployment accounting.
thm:stable-rank-adaptive-full-carrier-ob.gap: Neither closest theorem class supplies the joint result here: sharp adjusted-variance bounds do not by themselves select and deploy a copula-robust all-rank control-variate basis, while optimized interference variance estimation does not provide this unpaired-pilot, cross-world endpoint objective or its stability-price observable-regret comparison.  The theorem's own first-order conclusion still requires the full error sum to be \(o(n^{-1})\), including the exact stability price; no rate for that price is inferred.
thm:stable-rank-adaptive-full-carrier-ob.consumer: It is the end-to-end design-performance guarantee for a deployable all-rank pilot-selected basis.
